title: Release gate: close foo while it is answering, and reopen; quit from the menu and reopen

steps.text: Give me 5 tips to sleep better, one line each

steps.expect: foo is answering (Thinking row or words streaming)
after reopening, the question is answered, or the cut-off reply shows Try again; never 👀 or the Thinking row left forever

steps.note: no Thinking row stuck after the reopen

steps.expect: the menu shows Settings, Keyboard shortcuts and Quit only (batch 1)
reopens on the same chat with all earlier messages; no error card
a normal short reply after the restart
